note: Executable question graph for Groundwork: Requirements (GW-P4). The host agent consumes this via /api/agent/contract; the server applies the skip rules below server-side so a drifting agent cannot ask a skipped node. Each node also declares `dynamic` (default false): STATIC nodes carry their own prompt + chips/cards content in this graph and the SERVER serves them directly on /api/answer WITHOUT an agent turn (auto-advance); DYNAMIC nodes need agent-composed, user-word-derived content and flip the turn to await_agent so the host agent composes them (optionally pre-posted via the prefetch queue). The graph tests (designer/tests/test_survey_graph.mjs) walk this JSON with the same skip evaluator + dynamic split the server uses (exported isNodeSkipped / isNodeDynamic in survey-server.mjs).

skipVocabulary.platformTargetIn: skip this node when the resolved platformTarget is one of the listed values
skipVocabulary.startingPointIn: skip this node when the resolved startingPoint is one of the listed values
skipVocabulary.skipWhenObserved: default true; when true, skip the node if its feedsField is already an OBSERVED fact (inspection pre-filled it). Set false for genuine preferences that cannot be observed (tradeoff allocation, feature priority).

dynamicVocabulary.dynamic: default false. false (STATIC) = the node's prompt + chips/cards are fixed in this graph; the server serves it directly on the next /api/answer with no agent round-trip. true (DYNAMIC) = the content is composed by the host agent from the user's own prior answers; the turn flips to await_agent (or is served instantly from the prefetch queue if the agent pre-posted it).
dynamicVocabulary.fallback: REQUIRED on every dynamic node. A static { prompt, chips?, cards? } payload good enough to answer WITHOUT agent enrichment. When the walk reaches a dynamic node and NO host agent has polled /api/agent/contract within AGENT_ATTACH_WINDOW_MS (the agent stepped away, or the user is self-pacing with no agent attached), the server serves this fallback directly (like a static node) so the browser never hard-stalls. If an agent IS recently attached, the node still flips to await_agent so the agent can compose richer, user-word-derived content.

writers.observed: seed.platformSurfaces or seed.structuredObservations; source refs identify inspected repo artifacts
writers.decided: record.structuredObservations with sourceAnswerNodeIds that identify persisted DECIDED answers
writers.assumed: infer.observation; the server forces ASSUMED provenance

observationContract.unresolvedPolicy: A missing field remains in unresolved. The server and host must not synthesize architecture or promote an assumption to a decision.
